articles.author: YouTube Golf
articles.description:
Phil Kenyon, the world-renowned putting coach behind champions like Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler, hooks up with Peter Finch for an in-depth putting masterclass. They cover green reading, putter setup, stroke path, tempo and distance control—plus mindset drills and pro tips you can use right away to start sinking more putts.
Along the way you’ll find links to Phil’s website, a deep dive on strokes-gained stats and Finch’s gear page (with discount codes!). Whether you’re a total newbie or a low-handicap player, this session is a tour-level shortcut to lower scores on the greens.
articles.title: Peter Finch Golf: My Lesson With THE WORLD'S No1 PUTTING COACH | Phil Kenyon

articles.author: YouTube Golf
articles.description:
Rick Shiels, PGA pro and YouTuber, invites you to follow him and Harold on social media, subscribe to LIV Golf and his podcast, grab limited-edition merch, and check out his equipment review channel and apparel partner Redvanly.
His channel is all about helping you play and enjoy golf more—covering gear reviews, swing fixes (slice, hook, driving distance), iron play, chipping, pitching (including backspin), putting tips, plus head-to-head matches against top pros.
articles.title: Rick Shiels Golf: Do this to PURE Your Golf Irons!

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Noclip’s latest documentary features Danny O’Dwyer sitting down with Battlefield 3’s single-player lead designer David Goldfarb to unpack what made the campaign so divisive. They dive into each signature mission—from the jet-fueled “Going Hunting” and tank-heavy “Thunder Run” to the moody “Night Shift,” the intro level “Swordbreaker,” and the gritty Paris set-piece “Comrades.”
Along the way they chat about how Frostbite 2 shaped the game’s look and feel, the role of quick-time events, and what it was like remembering development years later. (Oh, and if you want to support more free game docs, yup—you know where the Patreon link is.)
articles.title: Noclip: The Story Behind Battlefield 3's Divisive Campaign - Noclip

articles.description:

Mark your Pokédex: the game launches October 16 on Nintendo Switch and the next-gen Nintendo Switch 2.
articles.title: IGN: Pokemon Legends: Z-A - Official Story Trailer | Pokemon Presents July 2025

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:

Expect the classic mechanics you love plus two formats, three battle modes and the ability to import your favorite creatures via Pokémon HOME. It’s headed to Nintendo Switch and mobile (iOS and Android) in 2026.
articles.title: IGN: Pokemon Champions - Official Overview Trailer | Pokemon Presents July 2025

articles.description:

Plus, starting July 23, both Switch and Switch 2 trainers can jump into a special Tera Raid Battle series to hunt Shiny Wo-Chien, Chien-Pao, Ting-Lu and Chi-Yu. Time to power up and snag those rares!
articles.title: IGN: Pokemon Scarlet and Violet - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Update and The Shiny Treasure Ruin Trailer

articles.description:

Get ready to flex your brain and your crafting skills in Pokémon Friends! Solve bite-sized daily puzzles to earn yarn, then use it to create adorable plushies of your favorite Pokémon—and deck out cozy rooms to show them off.
Pokémon Friends is available worldwide on July 22, 2025. Download it today on Nintendo eShop, Google Play or the App Store and start stitching up some fun!
articles.title: IGN: Pokemon Friends - Official Announcement Trailer | Pokemon Presents July 2025

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch’d & Pichu is a new stop-motion animated series from Pokémon and Aardman, slated for 2027. It spotlights Sirfetch’d and Pichu as unlikely heroes in a region fans know well—one that’s very close to Aardman’s heart.  
Told from the Pokémon’s point of view, the show promises the signature Aardman blend of quirky character, spot-on comedy, and meticulous craft, giving us a fresh, playful look at the world of Pokémon.
articles.title: IGN: Pokemon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd & Pichu - Official Teaser | Pokemon Presents 2025

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Ne Zha 2 looks to up the ante with Michelle Yeoh, Crystal Lee, Vincent Rodriguez III and Aleks Le bringing to life the rebel kid born with raw, uncontrollable powers—cursed by the gods yet destined to stand against an ancient force bent on humanity’s undoing.  
Produced by Wang Jing and Liu Wenzhang, written and directed by Jiao Zi, Ne Zha 2 storms into theaters on August 22, 2025.
articles.title: IGN: Ne Zha 2 - Official Trailer (2025) Michelle Yeoh, Vincent Rodriguez III, Aleks Le

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Karate Kid: Legends brings together two martial arts icons—Jackie Chan’s kung fu master Mr. Han and Ralph Macchio’s Daniel LaRusso—in a brand-new story. When young kung fu whiz Li Fong (Ben Wang) and his mom move to New York City, he bonds with a classmate and her dad, only to catch the eye of a local karate champ. To stand his ground, Li trains under both legends, blending kung fu and karate for an epic ultimate showdown.
Mark your calendars—Karate Kid: Legends drops on 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD on August 26, 2025.
articles.title: IGN: Karate Kid: Legends - Exclusive Deleted Scene (2025) Ben Wang, Wyatt Oleff

articles.description:
